name: Deathlock Wight (B)
languages: the languages it knew in life

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.text: The wight's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 13). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no verbal or material components: * At will: detect magic, disguise self, mage armor * 1/day each: fear, hold person, misty step

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.text: While in sunlight, the wight has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.
